name: dnd-presenter
description: Quick image/video presenter with control and second-screen display
author: DnD Presenter

scripts.dist:exe: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$outDir = 'dist/v' + $env:npm_package_version; electron-packager . 'DnD Presenter' --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=$outDir --overwrite --app-version $env:npm_package_version --win32metadata.CompanyName='DnD Presenter' --win32metadata.FileDescription='DnD Presenter' --win32metadata.ProductName='DnD Presenter' --win32metadata.OriginalFilename='DnD Presenter.exe'"
scripts.dist:zip: powershell -NoProfile -Command "npm run dist:exe; $baseDir = 'dist/v' + $env:npm_package_version; $appDir = Join-Path $baseDir 'DnD Presenter-win32-x64'; $zipPath = Join-Path $baseDir ('DnD Presenter-v' + $env:npm_package_version + '-win32-x64.zip'); Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $appDir '*') -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force"
